facts.statement: A Ghost Pet Party community event was held in a hidden location in the swamp, with players bringing a ghost pet, wearing a costume, and joining the fun.
facts.quote: Una fiesta para mascotas fantasmas que se llevara acabo en un oculto lugar en el Pantano de Esporaumbría

facts.statement: The Ghost Pet Party ran on Server 1 on Thursday 7 October 2010 at 15:00 Pacific Time for US and Latin America.
facts.quote: Jueves 7 de octubre del 2010 15:00 hrs Tiempo Pacifico (EE.UU. y Latino America) Servidor 1

facts.statement: A second run of the Ghost Pet Party ran on Server 1 on Friday 8 October 2010 at 09:00 Pacific Time, 16:00 European Time, for UK and Europe.
facts.quote: Viernes 08 de octubre del 2010 09:00 hrs. Tiempo Pacifico / 16:00 hrs. Tiempo Europeo (UK y Europa) Servidor 1

article_summaries.title: Evento Comunitario: Fiesta para Mascotas Fantasma (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event notice for the Super Spooktacular in October 2010: a Ghost Pet Party held in a hidden spot in the swamp, with two scheduled server-1 runs (Thursday 7 October 2010 and Friday 8 October 2010). It also describes the weekly community-event rhythm and how players find events through the Game Guide calendar.
